scenario.claim_text: During excavation, the contractor encounters materially different subsurface conditions and starts extra work without a timely notice trail. The source-safe answer is not to treat the field condition alone as an approved price increase. CIAP Document 102 requires the changed condition and extra-cost claim to move through written notice, owner investigation or instruction, and a change order when additional or different work is required.
